description: This file defines the TFAccessTokenRepository interface, which extends JPA repository interfaces for managing 2FA access tokens in the security domain of the Fineract system. It includes a method to find tokens by user and token string.

classes.name: TFAccessTokenRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for TFAccessToken entities, enabling CRUD operations and custom queries for two-factor authentication tokens.

methods.name: findByUserAndToken
methods.description: Finds a TFAccessToken entity based on the provided user and token string.
